pages.title: File:Dunmore-Head-and-Blasket-Islands.JPG

ObjectName.value: Dunmore-Head-and-Blasket-Islands

Categories.value: Taken with Sony DSC-HX100V|Blasket Islands|Dunmore Head|Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation

ImageDescription.value: The very tip of Dunmore Head, the westernmost point of Ireland, excluding islands, and most of the Blasket Islands showing in the background. In the back to the right is Inis Tuaisceart, in front of it the small Beginish, largest island to the right is Great Blasket Islands, and in the back to the right are Inishnabro and Inishvickillane. Tearaght Island is hidden behind the Great Blasket Island.
